# sfcompute_infiniband_partitions (Data Source)

Reads infiniband partitions from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/infiniband_partitions`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) An independent failure domain within a region, e.g. `a`.
- `ending_before` (String) Cursor for backward pagination.
- `fabric` (String) Return only partitions on this fabric, by fabric name.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by InfiniBand partition ID or resource path (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50).
- `starting_after` (String) Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).
- `workspace` (String) Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Without it, the returned list spans every workspace where the caller has `InfinibandPartition:List` and `InfinibandPartition:Read` (granted at either the workspace or organization level). If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String)
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String) An independent failure domain within a region, e.g. `a`.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `fabric` (String) InfiniBand fabric serving this partition. Partitions on different fabrics cannot reach each other.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String) The geographic region where the hardware is located, e.g. `europe-north1`.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a infiniband_partition resource. Format: sfc:infiniband_partition:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this partition belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--workspace))

<a id="nestedatt--data--workspace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.workspace`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
